realisationsPage.subtitle: Transport, industry, mining: see how our teams deploy geolocation, security and prevention for each type of project.
realisationsPage.noticeText: The cases below describe typical deployments built from our services. Our client case studies will be published soon, with the agreement of the companies involved.
realisationsPage.casesTitle: Three settings, one standard of traceability

cases.title: Securing a truck fleet on an international corridor
cases.challenge: Multi-day trips, unplanned stops and unexplained fuel losses, with no visibility between departure and arrival.
solution: GPS trackers fitted on every truck and trailer
Geofences at borders, depots and authorized rest areas
Alerts for long stops, detours or abnormal drops in fuel level
Live tracking from the Client Portal, on desktop and mobile

cases.title: Protecting an industrial site and its equipment, day and night
cases.challenge: A large site, valuable equipment and breakdowns that halt production without warning.
solution: Connected sensors and video surveillance on entrances and sensitive areas
Access control for vehicles and staff
Telemetry on critical machines and predictive maintenance
Real-time alerts sent to the security and maintenance teams

cases.title: Tracking machinery on a mining site and preventing breakdowns
cases.challenge: Heavy machinery spread across a remote site, poorly tracked engine hours and breakdowns that halt production for days.
solution: GPS trackers and sensors on every machine and service vehicle
Geofences around extraction areas, depots and authorized tracks
Engine-hour tracking and maintenance alerts before failure
Alerts for out-of-hours use or leaving the zone
tracked: Position and activity of each machine
